description: In the 3D model, as SketchUp's Dimension and Text tools: kind dimension measures start to end (model points: plan mm and height mm above the ground), its line set off by offset (mm, default 300 up), pinned to the elements on (start) and on_end (end) so it follows them when they move. kind text puts words (text) at a point (at), with a leader from start when given (pinned to on), or pinned to the screen with screen (x and y as shares of the view, 0–1, from the top left). Both show in the viewport, saved with the project; the user picks and deletes them like their own. Returns its id (and a dimension's length).

offset.description: Where the dimension line sits from its points, mm (x east, y north, height up)

on.description: Element id the start (or the text's leader) is pinned to

name: add_model_mark
title: Add a dimension or text in the model
